trace.description: TRACE core: durable context for AI-assisted development. Sets up the docs structure and AGENTS.md, records architecture decisions, distils durable knowledge as you work, validates the conventions, and measures context weight.
trace.defaultPrompt: Use TRACE to set up durable project context.

trace-plan.description: TRACE planning: specs with acceptance criteria, local epics, and browser review for both workflows.
trace-plan.defaultPrompt: Use TRACE to plan this change.

trace-git.description: TRACE delivery add-on: commit messages and PR descriptions in a predictable What / Approach / Updated context shape. No Conventional-Commits taxonomy.
trace-git.defaultPrompt: Use TRACE to draft a commit message.

trace-full.description: Everything TRACE ships, behind one install: the docs core plus the planning and delivery add-ons. Install this if you don't want to choose.
trace-full.defaultPrompt: Use TRACE to set up durable project context.
